capabilities: Upload images to configured platforms (Lskypro, Halo, GitHub) via right-click menu
Configure per-platform API request address, headers, and body
Extract the image URL from the API response and apply an optional URL prefix
Support GitHub uploads using base64-encoded content
extras: README is mostly in Chinese; a roadmap lists planned commands for uploading selected and all images, and installation via BRAT is mentioned.
problem: Obsidian stores images locally and has no built-in way to upload them to an external image host or blog storage.

requires.name: Authorization token for the target platform (Lskypro, Halo, or GitHub)

summary: Image upload plugin that sends vault files to external storage platforms (Lskypro, Halo, GitHub) via configurable HTTP APIs.
